s: Neo4j, relationships, Cypher query language, use cases
d: Graph databases model data as nodes and relationships. They excel at queries involving connections: social networks, recommendation engines, fraud detection, knowledge graphs. When your data IS the relationships, graphs outperform SQL joins.
c: Graph vs relational for connected data

p: Graphdb is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.
1. Understand the core principles and trade-offs.
2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
